twinIdea: Refactor the team workspace invites service to use a single Lambda orchestrator instead of Step Functions.
why: The task requires reviewing a design doc from multiple independent angles (security, performance, operations, cost, accessibility, data) against matching context files—k-aspect-review explicitly handles parallel n-aspect reviews using subagents, and adversarial-design-review stresses design decisions for gaps. A code review skill would mislead by suggesting code-level analysis.
